note: Identifiers only. Liftable rocks (Obj_LiftRock_A_01) and cuttable grass (Obj_Plant_Grass_A_01) as shuffled locations, one row per placed actor hash, so the adult and the child copy of one spot are two rows with their own saved row. item is the current Drop__DropActor and empty when the actor drops by table or by its default supply table. vanilla is the nominal item of the spot (the own drop, the item of its own table, else Rupee (1)). region is the logic region the spot is added to, chosen per area from the height and the side of the spot, and the harder region where two were possible. A spot can still sit in a region that is easier to reach than its true one. Which items they take is decided by the item rules of the pot slice, not by this catalog. Once they hold key items a region that is too easy can lock a seed, the fix is a row in data/logic/spot_overrides.json.
